evidence.detail: Table JSX hardcodes the 'live ' class prefix for all live-updating tables, coupling the live/updating semantics to the table-specific CSS namespace
Dozens of .live .column-name rules are table-specific; the issue notes .live was removed from metagamegrid to avoid conflicts, leaving .grid-header as a parallel namespace

triage.notes: Requires coordinated rename/split of the .live CSS namespace across pd.css (dozens of selectors), table.jsx, and potentially other JSX/HTML templates. Non-trivial scope, and incorrect refactoring could break live-updating table styling.
